turn2.differences: Author's c1-c4 repeat the request's wording without resolving the issue-vs-team attachment, so they match the literal request. My step-1 best reading took c3 as the issue's description; the records show the intended reading is the team's description.
turn2.naturalness_note: Real user would name the team directly ('Mobile' / MOB-1), not stack three field-level clues: visibility plus key substring plus description text.
